crossRefs.note: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he…
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew…
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they…
Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!
Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the…
They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach…
Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

translations.web: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
translations.bsb: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
translations.kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day
translations.asv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.
